gaps.sentence: The talks fell ___ when neither side would compromise on fishing rights.
gaps.explanation: 'Fall through' = (a plan or deal) fail to be completed.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: The rebels finally ___ down the government.
gaps.explanation: 'Bring down a government' = cause its collapse.

gaps.sentence: She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
